notes: Prose revision against the house standard for plain, declarative writing, respecting the author's recorded decisions in editorial.md (title and subtitle retained; 'Usefulness can end before membership does' kept as the last sentence; the contemporary implication left unspoken). Section titles made descriptive ('After the guidance program' became 'Introduction'; 'What a function holds together' became 'Working arrangements and distributed decommissioning'; 'When custody ends' became 'Disposal, retirement and the end of custody'; 'Becoming a problem' became 'Pigeons as an urban control problem'; 'Remaining in place' became 'Residence in infrastructure'; 'After usefulness' became 'Obligation after usefulness'). Removed self-reference ('This paper follows'), the rhetorical abstract opener, an inline ', not simply' contrast, 'merely' and 'precisely', epigrammatic lines ('A dropping had a destination and a buyer', 'A keeper's reliable return has become a building manager's failed removal') and the sweeping 'a problem larger than the history of domestication'. All 32 claims re-bound and passing.
